messages:
harper_sec: FYI: vendor pen-test scheduled Mon 07:00-11:00 PT. Need a concise handoff: RBAC snapshot, KMS-safe upload path, evidence manifest, and retest gating. Keep perms minimal.

mike_ops: Plan: presigned POST to a dedicated bucket `pt-lockbox-2026` with bucket default KMS CMK. No KMS permissions for assessors. Lifecycle 30d.

anya_platform: RBAC snapshot approach: run `aws iam list-roles` + `aws iam get-role --role-name` for in-scope roles, then sha256 the JSON. Store manifest next to the evidence tarball.

kevin_sre: For ephemeral creds use sts-mint endpoint to issue creds limited to `s3:PutObject` on `pt-<id>/*` and `s3:ListBucket` on prefix. Tag credentials with `pt_id` so CloudTrail filters easily.

olga_kms: Confirm: presigned uploads will avoid including KMS headers; bucket default encryption ensures objects are encrypted without granting `kms:Encrypt`. Do not allow `kms:GenerateDataKey`.

harper_sec: Triage & retest policy: critical -> 48h emergency retest; high -> 72h mitigation window then retest; medium/low -> schedule within 7-14 days. Retest requires PR/commit referencing ticket + CI evidence.

mike_ops: CS asked for allowed file types and naming. Proposal: allowed `.tgz,.zip,.json,.pcap`; naming: `<pt-id>/<assessor-id>/<YYYYMMDD_HHMM>_<sha256>.tgz`; single-object cap 8GB (multipart above 100MB).

executor-bot: Created SEC-2026-1350 "PT lockbox & RBAC snapshot" (assignee: mike_ops; due: 2026-04-10).

anya_platform: Dry-run checklist: mint STS creds -> perform presigned POST upload -> verify object encryption & tags -> run cloudtrail lookup for pt_id tag. Run 24h before engagement.

kevin_sre: I'll schedule a 20m dry-run slot and post curl/JS snippets in staging. If anyone sees policy gaps, flag them here.
